metadata.question: Does Somalia show lower soil moisture in April 2019 compared to the average April conditions?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use SMAP soil moisture data (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007) which provides global soil moisture data. For April 2019 and April average conditions (2015-2018 baseline). 2. Masking strategy: SMAP data is already processed, no additional cloud masking needed. 3. Logic: Calculate mean soil moisture for April 2019 vs average of April 2015-2018. If 2019 < baseline, answer A, else B. Data considerations: - SMAP collection: 'NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007' - Band: 'sm_surface' for surface soil moisture - Somalia geometry as polygon - Check collection sizes and valid pixel counts - Validate results are reasonable (soil moisture typically 0-0.6 m³/m³) Steps: 1. Define Somalia polygon 2. Get April 2019 soil moisture data 3. Get April 2015-2018 data for baseline average 4. Check collection sizes 5. Calculate means and validate 6. Compare and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var somalia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[40.981, 11.987], [51.412, 11.987], [51.412, -1.659], [40.981, -1.659], [40.981, 11.987]] ]); var april2019 = ee.DateRange('2019-04-01', '2019-04-30'); var baselineRange = ee.DateRange('2015-04-01', '2018-04-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition - SMAP Soil Moisture var smap2019 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') .filterBounds(somalia) .filterDate(april2019) .select('sm_surface'); var smapBaseline = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') .filterBounds(somalia) .filterDate(baselineRange) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) .select('sm_surface'); // Check collection sizes var count2019 = smap2019.size().getInfo(); var countBaseline = smapBaseline.size().getInfo(); print(`2019 April Images: ${count2019}`); print(`Baseline April Images: ${countBaseline}`); if (count2019 === 0 || countBaseline === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate means var mean2019 = smap2019.mean(); var meanBaseline = smapBaseline.mean(); // Check valid pixels var count2019Pixels = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: somalia, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); var countBaselinePixels = meanBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: somalia, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); print(`2019 Valid Pixels: ${count2019Pixels}`); print(`Baseline Valid Pixels: ${countBaselinePixels}`); if (count2019Pixels === 0 || countBaselinePixels === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation var soilMoisture2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); var soilMoistureBaseline = meanBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer print(`Soil Moisture 2019: ${soilMoisture2019.toFixed(4)}`); print(`Soil Moisture Baseline: ${soilMoistureBaseline.toFixed(4)}`); if (soilMoisture2019 === null || soilMoistureBaseline === null || isNaN(soilMoisture2019) || isNaN(soilMoistureBaseline) || soilMoisture2019 < 0 || soilMoisture2019 > 0.6 || soilMoistureBaseline < 0 || soilMoistureBaseline > 0.6) { print("C3"); } else if (soilMoisture2019 < soilMoistureBaseline) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
